site.description.en: Classroom-grounded learning tools for Chinese Language education, designed and built by a practising teacher.
site.description.zh: 由一线华文教师独立设计与开发的课堂学习工具。

hero.tagline.en: Chinese Language Teacher · Independent EdTech Builder · Head of Department, Mother Tongue Languages
hero.tagline.zh: 华文教师 · 独立教育科技开发者 · 百德中学母语部主任

hero.intro.en: My work starts the same way in every medium: I notice a structural gap, then build something to close it. I teach Chinese Language, lead a Mother Tongue department, and design tools around problems that come out of real classrooms.
hero.intro.zh: 无论在哪一个领域，我的工作都始于同一件事：察觉结构上的缺口，然后动手把它补上。我教华文，主持母语部门，也针对课堂中真实浮现的问题，亲手做出相应的工具。

grid.subtitle.en: Smaller classroom tools, each built for one specific teaching problem.
grid.subtitle.zh: 为解决某一个具体教学问题而做的小型课堂工具。

talks.subtitle.en: Sharing what I build so other teachers can adapt it rather than start from zero, and finding people to build with along the way.
talks.subtitle.zh: 把做出来的东西分享出去，让其他老师可以直接借鉴，而不必从零开始；也在这个过程中，遇到愿意一起做的人。

approach.body1.en: Two commitments sit underneath every turn of that loop and do not get renegotiated. Self-Determination Theory: students need autonomy, competence and relatedness to stay engaged. Assessment for Learning: feedback exists to move learning forward, not to rank. In practice they come down to three rules I hold in every build.
approach.body1.zh: 有两项承诺，垫在这个循环的每一圈底下，不参与谈判。自我决定理论（SDT）：学生需要自主感、胜任感与归属感，才能持续投入。促进学习的评价（AfL）：反馈的意义在于推动学习，而不是排名。落到实处，就是我在每一次开发中都守住的三条规则。

approach.principle1Body.en: A wrong answer never costs a student something already earned. The moment a system can take progress away, students start protecting a score instead of stretching.
approach.principle1Body.zh: 答错，绝不会让学生失去已经挣得的东西。一旦系统能夺走进度，学生就会开始保护分数，而不再愿意伸展自己。

approach.principle2Title.zh: 难度由学生选择，而非被指派

approach.principle2Body.en: Being placed in a lane by the system removes autonomy. Choosing a lane and finding it hard builds competence.
approach.principle2Body.zh: 被系统安排进某一条轨道，会剥夺自主感；自己选定一条，并发现它有难度，才能建立胜任感。

approach.principle3Title.en: Feedback lands before the next attempt
approach.principle3Title.zh: 反馈必须赶在下一次尝试之前

approach.principle3Body.en: Feedback delivered a week later is a grade. If a tool cannot respond within the same session, the pedagogy it claims is decorative.
approach.principle3Body.zh: 一周后才送到的反馈，是成绩。如果一个工具无法在同一堂课内做出回应，它所标榜的教学理念只是装饰。

contact.subtitle.en: Write to me if you would like to know more, or if there is something we could build together.
contact.subtitle.zh: 若想进一步了解，或有合作的想法，欢迎来信。

work.intro.en: Tools built for specific classroom problems, all of them in real use with real students.
work.intro.zh: 为具体课堂问题而做的工具，每一个都在真实课堂中使用。

embed.desktopOnly.en: This game needs a keyboard, so it is best opened on a computer.
embed.desktopOnly.zh: 这个游戏需要键盘操作，建议在电脑上打开。

approach.leadA.en: Design thinking is usually drawn as a tidy five step loop: empathise, define, ideate, prototype, test. In a classroom, only one of those steps ever settles anything. A tool is not good because the thinking behind it was good. It is good because thirty students opened it on a Monday morning and it held.
approach.leadA.zh: 设计思维通常被画成一个工整的五步循环：同理、定义、构思、原型、测试。但在课堂里，真正能定案的只有其中一步。一个工具之所以好，不是因为背后的想法好，而是因为三十个学生在星期一早上打开了它，而它撑住了。

approach.leadB.en: So I run the loop, but I run it short and I run it often. The gap comes from a real script or a real mark, not from a survey. The prototype is a working build, not a mockup. The test is a real lesson with students who will abandon anything that wastes their time. And the next version starts that same week, because by then the classroom has already told me what to fix.
approach.leadB.zh: 所以我照样跑这个循环，只是跑得短、跑得勤。缺口来自一份真实的答卷或一个真实的分数，而不是问卷。原型是一个能跑的版本，而不是一张示意图。测试是一堂真实的课，面对的是一群不会容忍浪费时间的学生。下一个版本就在同一周开始，因为课堂那时已经告诉我该改什么了。

approach.loop1Title.en: The gap has to be one I actually saw

approach.loop1Body.en: A gap I can point at is a design brief. A gap I assumed is a guess wearing a lanyard. One student's weak comprehension paper is what surfaced a cohort-wide problem for me, and the cohort is what the tool then had to answer to. I find the problem at the level of one student, and define it at the level of the class.
approach.loop1Body.zh: 能指出来的缺口，是设计任务；靠揣测得来的缺口，只是挂着工作证的猜想。一名学生的理解问答考卷，让我看见了整个级别的问题；而这个工具，此后要交代的对象就是整个级别。问题在一个学生身上被发现，在一个班的层面上被定义。

approach.loop2Title.en: Build the thing, not a picture of the thing
approach.loop2Title.zh: 做出东西，而不是东西的示意图

approach.loop2Body.en: A mockup cannot be evaluated, only admired. A working build can be handed to a student, and a student will tell you in forty seconds what a proposal deck could not tell you in a term. So I skip the polished pitch stage and ship something small that runs.
approach.loop2Body.zh: 示意图无法被检验，只能被欣赏。能跑的版本可以直接交到学生手上，而学生四十秒内告诉你的事，一份提案简报一个学期也说不出来。所以我跳过打磨提案的阶段，先交付一个小而能跑的东西。

approach.loop3Title.en: 实践 shíjiàn, putting it into practice: the classroom is the test, not the demo
approach.loop3Title.zh: 实践：课堂才是测试，演示不是

approach.loop3Body.en: Colleagues nodding at a demo is not evidence. Students using it unsupervised, in an ordinary lesson, with ordinary levels of patience, is evidence. Everything I have built went in front of real students within days of being usable, and most of what I now believe about the design was learnt there rather than beforehand.
approach.loop3Body.zh: 同事在演示时点头，不算证据。学生在一堂普通的课上、在无人盯着的情况下、带着普通的耐性使用它，才算证据。我做的每一样东西，在勉强能用的几天内就送到了学生面前；而我今天对设计的多数判断，都是在那里学到的，不是事先想到的。

approach.loop4Title.en: Let the evidence write the next version
approach.loop4Title.zh: 让证据来写下一个版本

approach.loop4Body.en: Which words keep failing. Which screen nobody visits. Which instruction I have to repeat out loud every single time. Those are the design documents. Opinions, including my own, get outranked by them.
approach.loop4Body.zh: 哪些词一错再错。哪个页面没人去。哪一句指示我每次都得再讲一遍。这些才是设计文档。任何意见，包括我自己的，都排在它们后面。

approach.loop5Title.en: The loop does not resolve, it climbs
approach.loop5Title.zh: 循环不会收束，它只会向上

approach.loop5Body.en: 实践、认识、再实践: practise, understand, practise again. No version is final and none of them was meant to be. Each turn of the loop begins from a better question than the last one, which is the only kind of progress I actually trust.
approach.loop5Body.zh: 实践、认识、再实践。没有哪一版是最终版，本来也不打算是。每一圈都从一个比上一圈更好的问题开始，而这是我唯一真正信得过的进展。
